description: Diagnostic count of entered components carried forward until a documented exit

description: Whether supply is observed for every municipality in the reviewed scope

notes: False rows retain missing capacity aggregates

description: Whether all municipalities in the reviewed scope have an observed hotel-night value
formula: observed municipality count equals expected municipality count
notes: False rows retain a missing aggregate

description: Whether every assigned SLF station-month passes the daily observation coverage gate
formula: all assigned station months have >=80% valid daily HS coverage
notes: False for future/unavailable months

description: Whether every assigned SwissMetNet station-month passes the four-parameter coverage gate
formula: all assigned station months have >=80% coverage for mean/min/max temperature and precipitation
notes: False for unavailable future months and five in-window destination-months

description: Worst resort-to-station comparability class among destination components
formula: worst of high/moderate/low component links
notes: Comparability class, not accuracy

description: Worst horizontal-distance comparability class among destination components
formula: worst of high/moderate/low component links
notes: Comparability class, not accuracy

description: Months relative to the first analytical membership anchor
formula: calendar month difference from first_analysis_anchor
notes: Not sufficient for causal event-study identification

description: Official bed occupancy rate for single-municipality destination units
formula: retained only when destination scope has exactly one municipality
notes: Not aggregated for Meiringen-Hasliberg

description: Additive available beds across the reviewed municipality outcome scope
formula: sum(municipality beds * 1.0), missing unless every scoped municipality is observed
notes: No imputation

description: Additive open establishments across the reviewed municipality outcome scope
formula: sum(municipality establishments * 1.0), missing unless every scoped municipality is observed
notes: No imputation

description: Additive hotel overnight stays across the reviewed municipality outcome scope
formula: sum(municipality hotel_overnights * 1.0), missing unless every scoped municipality is observed
notes: No imputation

description: Monthly live-table overnight stays per summed available bed
formula: summed live-table overnight stays / summed beds when beds > 0
notes: Not the official occupancy rate

description: Additive available rooms across the reviewed municipality outcome scope
formula: sum(municipality rooms * 1.0), missing unless every scoped municipality is observed
notes: No imputation

description: Unweighted mean monthly precipitation total across unique assigned SwissMetNet stations
formula: mean station-month precipitation_total_mm only when every assigned station month passes the 80% gate
notes: Not summed across stations; 06:00-to-06:00 UTC daily window

description: Unweighted mean monthly snow depth across unique assigned SLF proxy stations
formula: mean station-month snow_depth_mean_cm only when every assigned station month has >=80% daily coverage
notes: Not direct slope snow; missing months are not imputed

description: Whether the regional weather proxy has passed all causal-use validation gates
formula: always false at this checkpoint
notes: Station choice and gridded-data sensitivity remain pending

description: Minimum great-circle distance from any donor-municipality resort point to any resolved Magic Pass resort point
formula: minimum haversine distance over donor and resolved-Magic resort-point pairs
notes: Resolved Magic points are a lower bound and not tourism catchments

description: Sensitivity band for network-wide Magic proximity
formula: within 20 km, 20-30 km, 30-50 km or beyond 50 km
notes: Thresholds are not causal rules

description: Whether every resolved Magic resort point is more than 30 km from donor resort points
formula: minimum network distance > 30 km
notes: Does not prove absence of spillovers

description: Whether a donor listing shares a preserved lift cluster with a resolved Magic listing
formula: intersection of donor and resolved-Magic cluster IDs
notes: Existing clusters are provisional geographic groupings

description: Within-treatment rank of the descriptive comparability score
formula: descending score rank among usable provisional donors
notes: Top five are shortlisted; rank is not a causal weight

description: Within-treatment heuristic score used to prioritise manual donor review
temporal_level: 36-month pre-anchor window plus current structure snapshot
formula: 100 * (1 - mean within-treatment percentile rank across nine lower-is-better gaps)
notes: Scores are not comparable across treatments and do not approve controls

description: Months in the 36-month pre-anchor window with observed outcomes for both treatment and donor
formula: count of dates where both hotel_overnights values are observed
notes: At least 30 required for the descriptive rank

description: Correlation of paired log1p monthly hotel overnight stays in the pre-window
formula: Pearson correlation of paired log1p outcomes
notes: Seasonality can inflate correlation; not a parallel-trends test

description: Absolute gap between treated and donor monthly log trends after calendar-month adjustment
formula: absolute difference between separate OLS time coefficients with calendar-month indicators
notes: Short-window descriptive slope without causal interpretation

description: Whether the pair has enough outcome months and comparability components for descriptive ranking
formula: >=30 paired outcome months and >=6 available score components
notes: Does not imply causal usability

description: Whether accessibility was reviewed or became unnecessary after an independent exclusion
formula: accessibility status contains no pending marker
notes: Does not mean historical accessibility is stable

description: Status of road/rail/accessibility review or reason it is moot after exclusion

description: Qualified status of competing multi-resort pass evidence around the treatment anchor

description: Station and place-name variants searched in the complete annual roster

notes: Label review is not a corporate-register affiliate audit

description: Current evidence-priority decision after network distance and external-shock review

notes: A retain decision means more audit is needed, not approval

description: Whether a complete annual roster documents absence under reviewed donor station/place labels

notes: All seven remote pairs have documented label absence; this is not corporate-register affiliate proof

description: Whether complete-roster station/place-label absence is documented

description: Qualified result of the donor operator investment and local tourism shock review

description: Absolute gap between pooled shares of observed winter days with snow depth at least 30 cm
formula: abs(selected pooled reliability share - alternative pooled reliability share)
notes: External-station reliability proxy only

description: Rule-based overall agreement grade for the station perturbation
formula: high/moderate/low thresholds over correlation, relative depth gap and reliability gap
notes: Conservative descriptive grade; not measurement accuracy

description: Next-nearest distinct eligible SLF station used for the robustness perturbation
formula: nearest eligible code after excluding the primary selected station
notes: Not an optimised or piste-level substitute

description: Great-circle distance from the resort point to the alternative station
formula: haversine distance
notes: Does not capture terrain barriers or aspect

description: Whether the snow proxy passes the causal covariate gate
formula: always false at this checkpoint
notes: Independent gridded sensitivity and snowmaking/operation data remain missing

description: Winters usable for both primary and alternative stations
formula: count of common winters where both stations meet the 80% within-winter gate
notes: At least eight required for an agreement grade

description: Mean absolute selected-versus-alternative gap in winter mean snow depth
formula: mean(abs(selected winter mean HS - alternative winter mean HS))
notes: Absolute levels can remain materially station-dependent

description: Mean absolute winter-depth gap relative to the selected-station mean
formula: mean absolute depth difference / selected mean depth
notes: Descriptive scale-normalised discrepancy

description: Whether selected and alternative linear winter-depth slopes have the same sign
formula: selected slope * alternative slope >= 0
notes: No uncertainty test; short descriptive series

description: Correlation of November-April mean snow depth between selected and alternative stations
formula: Pearson correlation across common usable winters
notes: Co-movement does not imply equal absolute depth

description: Rule-based spatial/elevation comparability class
formula: high if <=10 km and <=500 m gap; moderate if <=25 km and <=1000 m; otherwise low
notes: Comparability class, not measurement accuracy

description: SLF station selected as an external mountain snow proxy
formula: geographically nearest snow station among stations with >=80% longitudinal winter coverage
notes: Never interpreted as direct slope representation

description: Great-circle distance from resort listing point to selected SLF station
formula: haversine distance between supplied resort coordinate and station coordinate
notes: Does not capture terrain barriers or aspect

description: Absolute elevation difference between the SLF station and published resort-top altitude
formula: abs(station elevation - Bergfex resort top altitude)
notes: Resort base/mid elevations are unavailable

description: Linear trend in proxy-station winter mean snow depth
formula: OLS slope of winter mean HS on winter start year over usable seasons
notes: Short series; descriptive only; no uncertainty model yet

description: Share of valid November-April proxy-station days with snow depth >=30 cm
formula: sum station days HS>=30 / sum valid winter days across usable seasons
notes: May be shared by multiple resorts mapped to one station

description: Inverse of the proxy-station winter-day snow reliability share
formula: 1 - snow_reliability_share_days_ge_30cm
notes: Not a piste-level vulnerability measure and not yet approved for scoring
